attempts.summary: Built a site-to-site WireGuard tunnel between node1 and node2 over their transit network, routing node3's private lan-a (192.168.10.0/24) and node4's private lan-b (192.168.20.0/24) across it. node3 and node4 now reach each other by private address, and packet captures confirm the transit link carries only encrypted WireGuard UDP (port 51820), no plaintext ICMP visible. All four nodes were then restarted one at a time (preserving connectivity throughout) and verified to come back with new boot identities and fully recovered tunnel/routing state.
